title: W3NPAY
tagline: Web3 Venmo - Send and request crypto payments to people that have an EVM wallet.
description:
W3NPAY is Web3 version of Venmo.  W3NPAY allows sending and requesting payments with the option of adding memos to the transaction.
W3NPAY also helps you manage the wallets you interact with the most and sorts them order in descending order from most interactions to least. No more asking your friends to send you their address, or you sending them yours. No more copying and pasting addresses just to send or receive crypto  from others. W3NPAY keeps your Web3 payments organized.
how_its_made:
The Tools we used
-Send and request crypto payments 
* Dune API to gather EOA interactions
* ENS - Gather user names
* XMTP - Attach a memo to a payment or payment request .Proposed change for xmtp: return the message ID when sending a message. 
* Polygon - Deploy smart contract on Polygon
